member.name: M:quantiva.framework.dependecyannotation.DependecyAnnotationConfig.AddDependencyAnnotation(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection,System.Reflection.Assembly[])
member.summary: Registers annotated classes found only in the given assemblies. Use it to scan assemblies that are not loaded yet or to limit the scan.
member.param: The service collection to add registrations to.

list.item: Only concrete classes are considered (abstract and open generic classes are ignored).

The concrete type is always registered with its lifetime. Each implemented interface (except those in System*/Microsoft* namespaces, e.g. ) is forwarded to that registration, so all interfaces of a class resolve to the same instance.
Idempotent: a class already registered as a service is skipped, so calling the method twice does not duplicate registrations.
Types that cannot be loaded from an assembly () are ignored instead of failing.
A class with several lifetime attributes uses the first one in this order: scoped, singleton, transient.

member.name: T:quantiva.framework.dependecyannotation.ScopeService
member.summary: Marks a class to be registered automatically with the lifetime when is called.
member.remarks: Lifetime: one instance per scope (per HTTP request in ASP.NET Core). The concrete type is registered with this lifetime and every non-framework interface it implements is forwarded to the same registration (same instance). The attribute is inherited by derived classes and can only be applied to classes.

member.name: T:quantiva.framework.dependecyannotation.SingletonService
member.summary: Marks a class to be registered automatically with the lifetime when is called.
member.remarks: Lifetime: a single instance for the lifetime of the application; it must be thread-safe. The concrete type is registered with this lifetime and every non-framework interface it implements is forwarded to the same registration (same instance). The attribute is inherited by derived classes and can only be applied to classes.

member.name: T:quantiva.framework.dependecyannotation.TransientService
member.summary: Marks a class to be registered automatically with the lifetime when is called.
member.remarks: Lifetime: a new instance every time it is requested. The concrete type is registered with this lifetime and every non-framework interface it implements is forwarded to the same registration (same instance). The attribute is inherited by derived classes and can only be applied to classes.
